articles.title: AI giant Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with 'Chinese spy'
articles.summary: Tech giant Nvidia is investigating reports that chief executive Jensen ⁠Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.

articles.title: Seven dead and 114 injured in train crash near Cairo
articles.summary: At least seven people have died and more than 100 have been left injured in a major train crash south of Cairo, according to the Egyptian Chief Prosecutor’s office.

articles.title: One dead in Russia after Ukraine drone attack - as emergency workers struck by Moscow
articles.summary: One person has died after being hit by a Ukrainian drone attack in western Russia, while Moscow has struck emergency workers on rescue missions.

articles.title: Trump 'only kidding' about offering UFC boss press secretary job
articles.summary: Donald Trump has said he was "only kidding" about UFC boss Dana White becoming White House press secretary.

articles.title: Briton among six killed by 'far-right' gunman in Krakow rampage
articles.summary: A 32-year-old British man is among six people killed in a mass shooting in Krakow, in which another Briton was wounded, Polish officials have said.
